verdict: NOT READY for the owner's sample/PDF. The structure, language and mechanical layout pass, but content parity with HE fails on four page pairs, and 14 BIOSPICULE product photos are the outdated ones. Checked by reading Figma directly; nothing was modified. (a) PASS: the page is named "EXPORT — RU — Дизайн 40" and holds exactly 40 frames named "RU — 01 …" to "RU — 40 …". Their x/y match the HE grid exactly, layer order runs 40→1, each frame has exactly one PDF export setting, no descendant has one, and there is nothing else on the page. Backup page 1091:2 has 0 export settings. (b) Every text node of all 40 HE/RU page pairs was read and compared by meaning. The ToC is correct: 8 sections, MITOTECH as section 5 with "Advanced skin to cell delivery system", the MITOTECH line in section 7, no page numbers (HE has none either). MITOTECH pp.20–23 match the owner's text v2 and canon-v2 completely and in natural Russian. pp.19 and 38 are complete. FAIL on: blocks sitting on the wrong page in 6/7, 8/9 (both flagged in the change list as owner decisions E6.8/E8.5), and 30/31, 33/34 (not flagged anywhere); BIOSPICULE photos on 10 pages; the spray photo on pp.24–25. (c) PASS: 0 Hebrew letters, 0 RLM/LRM/bidi/zero-width characters in text or layer names, 0 words mixing Cyrillic and Latin. Latin product names are unchanged. MITOTECH terms match protocols-ru.md word for word ("Концентрированный порошок – 4 × 154 мг", "Активные ампулы-бустеры – 4 × 15 мл", "Рекомендуемая дозировка: 0,5 мл…", "Каждая пара флаконов…", "Всего до 60 процедур!"). Only small wording and typography items remain. (d) PASS numerically: 0 text ink boxes outside the frame, 0 null ink, 0 text-on-text overlaps over 2 px. The text-over-image hits on pp.1, 9, 18, 35 and 37 are transparent pack-shot margins, confirmed on screenshots. Every flagged p.22 icon vector (over the step 1 and step 2 texts and the step 5 title) is masked by its clip group and renders clean. MITOTECH pp.20–23 are mirrored (image on the right on p.20, columns swapped on 21/23, steps 1→5 left to right on 22, icons moved but not flipped). Titles are ExtraBold "MITOTECH " + Light "CELL BOOSTER" at 30, and no SemiBold remains anywhere. The only geometry nit is the p.38 caption. (e) Screenshots compared HE|RU for pp.1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 11, 14, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 25, 28, 38, 40, and RU only for pp.9, 17, 18, 27, 35, 37. Open owner questions from the change list ("с 28 до 7 дней", "AGING", p.24 title size, MITOTECH line in ToC section 7, applicators line) are not counted as defects.

issues.problem: The 'Salicylic Acid + Citric Acid' heading and text sit on RU p.30. On HE they open p.31 (HE 796:27: Salicylic → Sodium Hyaluronate/Glycerin/Betaine → how-to; HE p.30 has only Sponge, Niacinamide, Galactomyces, Sodium DNA). So RU p.30 has one extra ingredient and RU p.31 is missing it. The change list missed this, and the writer's report does not mention it.
issues.fix: Move 667:666 and 667:667 into auto-layout 678:4 on RU p.31 at index 0 and 1, before 667:668. Set 678:4.itemSpacing from 20 to 9 (the same as 672:44 on p.30). Estimated column bottom is y≈460; the limit is ≈505, with the panel footer 1110:21 at y 516. On p.30, move Galactomyces 667:661 and 667:662 from 672:43 to the top of 672:44, above Sodium DNA 667:664. That rebalances the columns and gives HE's order (Sponge, Niacinamide | Galactomyces, Sodium DNA). Then re-run the ink/footer check on both pages.

issues.problem: 'Yeast Beta-Glucan' and 'Экстракты Akebia Quinata и Camellia Japonica' (headings and texts) sit on RU p.33. On HE they are on p.34, above 'אופן השימוש' (HE 796:90). HE p.33 ends with Hydrolyzed Collagen and Adenosine. So RU p.33 has two extra blocks and RU p.34 has only the how-to. The change list missed this too.
issues.fix: Move the 4 nodes into auto-layout 678:5 on RU p.34 at index 0–3, before 667:629 'Способ применения'. Set 678:5.itemSpacing from 25 to 7 and its y from 176 to 162. Set the line height to 15 px on 667:626, 667:628 and 667:630 (12/15, as on RU p.6). Estimated bottom is y≈494; the limit is ≈505, with the panel footer 1110:28 at y 516. Check the result with absoluteRenderBounds. RU p.33 then ends with Collagen and Adenosine, as on HE.

issues.fix: Replace the U+002D at the hyphen position with '—' (U+2014), keeping the NBSP before it. Use deleteCharacters then insertCharacters at the same index so the style is kept.

issues.problem: 'Профессиональные процедуры - кожа головы' uses a hyphen as a dash, the same issue as p.4.
